Setup:------------------------IMPORTANT: Make sure that "capture gamepad when vnyan not focused" is turned on in Misc Settings
[BASIC:]
- 	Toggle the prop you would like to use for your 		controller prop in the green prop node

-	Set your hotkey and/or websocket command 		you would like to use to activate this graph in the 		cyan nodes...that's it! Not all models are the same however and you'll likely need to tweak finger positioning. This is where it gets sweaty (sorry!!)[ADVANCED:]-	Tweak your bone positions using the large 			controller tracking node graph blocks 				above/below this node block (settings for button 		positioning are on the right side of each block 		and are coloured red/blue to stand out). 

	The red ones work with your right hand, and the	 	blue ones work with your left.

-	The bone rotation nodes that activate when you 		press buttons are located on the far right hand 		side.

-	To fine tune your thumbstick rotations, adjust 		values in the Lerp Vector nodes. These can be 		found in the lower left corners of the large node 		blocks above and below this one.

These parameters control the following (1 is yes, 0 is no). All parameters are provided in Left/Right hand pairs:
<RHControllerActive> & <LHControllerActive>
	-	Toggles to enable/disable the pose and tracking effects based off hotkey or websocket 			input.

<RightControllerActive> & <LeftControllerActive>

	-	Determines whether or not data is sent to pose bones for the left and right hands.

<LMRightControllerActive> & <LMLeftControllerActive>
	-	Determines whether or not the leap motion device is currently tracking your left and 			right hands. 

<RHControllerLeapMotionPause> & <LHControllerLeapMotionPause>

	-	Determines whether or not to pause the bone posing if your leap motion has started 			tracking your hands. This value is compared to <RHControllerActive> & 					<LHControllerActive> via boolean AND to determine which logic state to trigger.<RThumbProximalX/Y/Z>, <RThumbIntermediateX/Y/Z>
<LThumbProximalX/Y/Z>, <LThumbIntermediateX/Y/Z>	-	The end result of Lerp calculations based off your gamepad joystick X and Y input are 			stored here. These are used to animate your thumbs while moving your joysticks.
	
	-	The lerp node values were set to help emphasize finger movement based off my 				camera position and the joysticks movements will be exaggerated for heightened 				visibility. Adjust these numerical values if you'd like something a bit more grounded.
